Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Sedona Digital is a leading provider of IT Consulting and Services, specialising in Cloud Solutions, Software Engineering, Security, and Data & AI. We partner with enterprises to optimise their technology estates, delivering flexible engagement models ranging from augmentation to outcome-based projects and managed teams. At Sedona, we thrive on solving complex challenges. By blending design, engineering, and analytics, we help organisations harness the power of technology to create innovative digital experiences and shape their future.
As part of our continued growth, we are seeking a talented and experienced Quality Assurance Manual Engineer to join our dynamic team. As a key member of our Agile development environment, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the quality of our software products throughout the development life cycle. Your responsibilities will include participating in Agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives, where you will champion quality as a top priority.
 Your activities will include: 
Analyze and interpret business requirements, features, and technical implementations 
Uphold quality standards throughout the entire software development lifecycle 
Ensure all functional and non-functional requirements are met 
Stay updated on the latest trends and technologies in database (DB) and API testing 
Track and resolve issues promptly, ensuring continuous improvement 
Manage in-house testing documentation and regularly review test strategies 
 Requirements
Over 3 years of experience in manual testing, with a strong background in GUI and API testing 
Proficiency in SQL and database fundamentals 
In-depth knowledge of software testing concepts and methodologies 
Prior Insurance domain expertise is a plus 
Basic knowledge of Git 
Proficiency in any scripting language and automated testing 
Familiarity with various API protocols and technologies 
ISTQB or other relevant testing certifications 
BSc/MSc in Computer Science, Finance, or a related field 
Excellent interpersonal, organizational, written, and verbal communication skills 
Commitment to excellence, methodical, analytical, and meticulous approach to work
 Benefits
Remote/home working 
Opportunity to work in a rapidly growing scale-up organisation 
Medical insurance given after probation period 
Ongoing learning and development opportunities 
Holiday allowance in line with local legislation 
Additional Paid Time Off - Extra days off for special occasions, supporting wellbeing and work-life balance 
Competitive compensation package 
Performance - based bonus 
Fun budget for team events
